claim_tested: For any two nonzero configurations supported in a common W-cell interval with the observer at R=floor(W/2)-1, unequal left edges imply a center disagreement at some time 0<=t<=2W.
method: Enumerate every nonzero W-bit row, group exact time-ordered center trace prefixes, stop at the first unequal-left-edge collision. Validate any witness independently with literal physical-coordinate Rule30.
interpretation: A collision refutes only this proposed linear horizon, never EdgeObservable. No collision is finite evidence only, not a theorem. No enlargement after this run.
